INPUTS_JSON: {"operation":"command","mode":"sync","timeout_minutes":"15","workdir":"/opt/madworld","command":"set -euo pipefail; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; ./ops/backup_daily.sh; newpass=\"$(openssl rand -hex 32)\"; db_user=\"$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_USER=//p' .env | head -1)\"; db_name=\"$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_DB=//p' .env | head -1)\"; db_user=\"${db_user:-madworld}\"; db_name=\"${db_name:-madworld_db}\"; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U \"$db_user\" -d \"$db_name\" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v newpass=\"$newpass\" -c \"ALTER ROLE \\\"$db_user\\\" PASSWORD :'newpass';\"; NEWPASS=\"$newpass\" python3 - <<'PY2'\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport os,re\nfrom urllib.parse import urlsplit,urlunsplit,quote\np=Path('.env'); s=p.read_text(); new=os.environ['NEWPASS']; s=re.sub(r'(?m)^POSTGRES_PASSWORD=.*$', 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD='+new, s)\ndef repl(m):\n u=urlsplit(m.group(2)); user=u.username or ''; host=u.hostname or ''; netloc=quote(user,safe='')+':'+quote(new,safe='')+'@'+host; netloc += ':'+str(u.port) if u.port is not None else ''; return m.group(1)+urlunsplit((u.scheme,netloc,u.path,u.query,u.fragment))\ns=re.sub(r'(?m)^(MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=)(.+)$', repl, s); p.write_text(s)\nPY2\nchmod 600 .env; docker compose --env-file .env -f ops/docker-compose.production.yml -f ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml up -d --force-recreate api world-tick-worker migrator; unset NEWPASS newpass; docker compose --env-file .env -f ops/docker-compose.production.yml -f ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml ps; printf '%s\\n' CREDENTIAL_ROTATION_DONE"}
